study.question: Observed starting point: static AUC 0.6050036145 / Logloss 0.1972554941, pooled 0.6102261137 / 0.1970864634, DIN 0.6133619861 / 0.1967946465 on 3234051 validation impressions (159437 positives, 3074614 negatives; prevalence 0.04929947). DIN exceeds pooling by 0.0031358724 overall, 0.0026743907 with category matches (2516922 rows, 129821 positives, 2387101 negatives), and 0.0002617450 without (717129 rows, 29616 positives, 687513 negatives). These differing slice effects motivate asking whether a small direct readout of absolute, field-specific target evidence by behavior type adds value beyond the normalized summary. The source establishes a structural limitation: uniformly duplicating identical history tuples leaves softmax pooling unchanged, while absolute counts change, provided no truncation boundary is crossed. The score slices alone do not establish that information loss causes predictive error; this proposal tests that uncertainty. Host receipts provide a reproducible successful starting lineage, not an agent re-audit of inaccessible raw schemas or causal-prefix tests.
study.hypothesis: Provisional mechanism: the single normalized history vector makes absolute target-conditioned support and the action identity of that support hard to read out jointly. A separate small residual head on masked count statistics can preserve category, brand and same-event joint matches by pv/cart/fav/buy, distinguishing generic activity from behavior-specific target evidence. Useful joint structure predicts incremental target effects and incremental action effects in the full factorial, rather than a gain solely from generic recency/volume features. This is a mechanism-distinct augmentation of the supplied reference, not a claim that count/time summaries or interest intensity are new. No mechanism has controlled support yet.

nearest_work.difference: DIN already drops softmax normalization to retain intensity. Our supplied reference instead normalizes, so this is a local implementation limitation, not a newly discovered limitation of original DIN. We retain the local backbone and add an explicit match-by-action count readout; this does not reproduce original unnormalized DIN. A future learned unnormalized-attention replacement would distinguish that simpler explanation.

EDIN/DINMP already aggregates count/time evidence and uses partitioned interests. Its advertising setup uses category/brand summaries with browsing only and a different split. Here a residual head reads exact target equality and joint equality by four actions from the fixed 128-event prefix, alongside a fixed normalized backbone. No sparse full-history compression, learned time-aware attention, self-attention over partitions, or transferred reported gain is asserted. This is a scoped adaptation; global novelty remains unverified.

Only the author README field warning was verified: these behavior logs supply category, brand and action, without item identity. The candidate uses precisely those supplied fields plus causal age. No paper-mechanism comparison or DMR reproduction claim is made because its full text was unavailable.

study.proposed_difference: Append a bias-free 32->32->1 ReLU residual to the original logit, initialized with zero final weights; preserve baseline module initialization order. 32 inputs = 4 action channels x 2 fixed kernels (all events and exp(-age_seconds/86400)) x 4 evidence channels (generic count, category equality, brand equality, conjunction on the same event). Each count is transformed as log1p(count)/log(129); zero IDs cannot match. Missing or empty histories generate exactly zero residual, including after training. The two factors are target_match and separate_actions. target_match=False replaces the three match channels with generic counts; separate_actions=False pools action counts then divides by four and broadcasts, preserving total mass across nominal slots. The four cells are standalone modules with the same 1056 added dense parameters (expected total 17131331 under the supplied reference metadata); no extra embeddings, losses, optimizers or history access. Diagnostics expose 23 descriptive finite scalars from the host-defined first 512 validation rows only. No label-derived selection or memory writes occur in model code. Only proposal.json and four candidate model modules are written; evidence.jsonl remains read-only and personal knowledge is disabled. The prospective record is the authorized local artifact for host retention.
predictions: Primary performance prediction: full match_actions improves full-population validation AUC over baseline-din by at least 0.0005 at matched recipe. An isolated seed-42 gain is preliminary; seek mean paired gain at least 0.0005 and consistent direction across seeds 42/43/44 before a repeated-support description. This threshold is a practical decision rule, not a significance test.

Specificity prediction: match_actions outperforms generic_actions, and match_pooled outperforms generic_pooled; target-match information should contribute beyond generic volume/recency. These are paired incremental effects, not causal conclusions from raw subgroup AUC levels.

Behavior prediction: match_actions outperforms match_pooled. Compute factorial interaction as [AUC(match_actions)-AUC(generic_actions)]-[AUC(match_pooled)-AUC(generic_pooled)]. A positive interaction would strengthen a joint-structure interpretation; absence of interaction still permits additive contributions and must not be described as synergy.

Secondary prediction: Logloss does not worsen by more than 0.0001 absolute versus the baseline. AUC-only gains with materially poorer calibration are reported separately and do not establish broad quality improvement.

Exploratory localization: assess incremental effects in existing category-match present/absent, cart/fav/buy present/absent and history-length slices with supplied sample/positive/negative counts; do not assume category absence implies brand absence. Existing slices motivated selection, so they are not independent confirmation. Empty-history readout is algebraically zero; shared-backbone retraining can still change those predictions.

The full model and controls add exactly 1056 parameters, but measured wall/GPU cost, memory and batch latency may change. No equal-compute or serving-speed claim is justified by parameter count alone.
falsifiers: If match_actions does not outperform baseline-din after paired repetitions, this implementation does not establish predictive usefulness; retain null and negative receipts rather than declaring the abstract mechanism refuted.

If generic_actions matches or exceeds match_actions, observed benefit is consistent with generic activity/recency readout rather than target-match specificity. If pooled-action variants match or exceed typed variants, action identity has no demonstrated incremental value.

If the factorial interaction is nonpositive or inconsistent across seeds, withhold synergy claims. If only one factor contributes, simplify the explanation and consider retaining its simpler cell for later validation-based selection.

If measured benefits disappear across paired seeds or uncertainty is unresolved, retain only provisional local observations. No confidence interval is invented from aggregate AUCs or repeated impressions treated as independent.

Any illegal input access, nonfinite logits/diagnostics, shape failure, nonzero empty-history evidence residual, resource cap failure or protocol mismatch is an implementation/integrity failure, distinct from scientific counterevidence.
alternative_explanations: Removing identity or target information changes feature rank and distribution despite identical nominal parameter count and architecture; controls are functional replacements, not equal effective capacity.

Matching uses encoded category/brand IDs. Unknown bucketing/collisions may create false equalities; ID zero is excluded from matches, but no raw-ID reconstruction or unavailable item identity is assumed.
Both target and action information remain in the common learned DIN backbone. Contrasts test the incremental direct readout, not removal of those inputs from the whole model.
Joint training may change the shared backbone; residual size is descriptive and is not a causal mediation measurement.
Counts only describe the supplied truncated prefix. Global-history slice membership may differ from available-prefix evidence; no long-history recovery is claimed.
Generic activity volume, missingness and recency may explain gains without target-specific or behavior-specific structure.

Original DIN already retains learned intensity; its unnormalized relevance sum might explain the same improvement more simply. This round does not isolate fixed counts from learned unnormalized attention, so it supports at most the local direct-readout hypothesis.
Fixed one-day decay and exact matches may be poorly adapted to the available history; a null result may reflect scale, coarseness or insufficient repetition, not absence of useful richer relevance.
Snapshot as-of dates are undocumented. This remains a static benchmark comparison, not verified production point-in-time performance.

All three available ancestor trajectories succeeded; no failed model branch is present in this context. Failed reference resolution and blocked paper fetching are retrieval limitations, not failed model experiments or negative scientific findings.
